prompt:
Check one candidate model relation against sentences of a long engineering document. Unit ids show the order of the sentences in the document; the sentences come from different places.

Candidate: Ground Handling Dispatcher provides "the Towbar Shortage Report" to Ramp Control Lead (an information or material flow).

Evidence sentences used to propose the candidate:
S522: The Handling Resource Planner assigns a severity level to the handler exception and suppresses duplicate updates while the accountable party is still working the same recovery action.
S523: The Ground Handling Dispatcher sends the Towbar Shortage Report when towbar availability cannot support the agreed pushback sequence.
S555: The Regional Flow Manager considers repeated remote stand transfer delays as an input to tactical capacity assessment during peak arrival and departure banks.
S556: Ramp Control Lead uses the Towbar Shortage Report to determine whether remote stand aircraft can be repositioned without creating secondary apron congestion.

Other sentences of the same document that mention this item, a similarly named item, or another element that produces or sends such an item:
S046: The shared operational picture includes Flight Intent Message status, Airport Capacity Plan assumptions, Target Off Block Time values, Calculated Takeoff Time values, Airport Acceptance Rate constraints, Common Situation Display content, Tactical Regulation Proposal status, Collaborative Decision Log entries, and Post Operations Report outputs.
S074: The Performance Analytics Warehouse retains the baseline inputs, capacity declarations, and approval timestamps so the Post Operations Report can compare planned performance with actual outcomes.
S099: At the end of each tactical period, accountable roles confirm that decisions and unresolved issues are available to the Performance Analytics Warehouse for later inclusion in the Post Operations Report.
S689: The Post Operations Report includes swap volume, rejection reasons, approval latency, compliance with revised times, and any equity concerns identified during the operating period.
S737: After restoration, the Performance Analytics Warehouse receives the outage timeline, manual intervention record, and recovery milestones for inclusion in the Post Operations Report.
S808: The Regional Flow Manager shall use the Post Operations Report to identify whether noncompliance resulted from operator choice, airport constraint, airspace constraint, weather impact, or system issue.
S841: The principal delay absorption indicator shall report minutes absorbed at origin, minutes remaining in the arrival stream, and minutes transferred to surface queues within the region.
S862: The Post Operations Report shall present regional benefits alongside operational trade-offs so that decision makers can see whether delay, queue, slot, cancellation, and emissions objectives were balanced in practice.
S982: The Performance Analytics Warehouse and Post Operations Report should be used to measure compliance, delay outcomes, capacity use, and the effectiveness of collaborative decisions.

Answer "supported" only if the document states that Ground Handling Dispatcher produces or sends this item AND that Ramp Control Lead receives or uses the same item (it may be named more briefly in one sentence), and no other sentence shows that the item Ramp Control Lead uses comes from a different producer or is a different item with a similar name. Answer "unsupported" if the sentences describe different items, the wrong elements, the opposite direction, or if another producer of the item the consumer uses is stated. Answer "uncertain" if the text is not clear enough. Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
response: {"verdict":"supported","reason":"S523 states the Ground Handling Dispatcher sends the Towbar Shortage Report, S556 states Ramp Control Lead uses the same report, and no other sentence names a different producer or a similarly named item."}
